drug_law.note: NDPS Act: small-quantity possession 6 months–1yr; intermediate 10yrs; commercial 10–20yrs. Bhang (cannabis preparation) tolerated culturally in some states (Holi etc.) but ganja/charas/hashish strictly illegal.

lgbtq.note: Section 377 struck down 2018; same-sex marriage rejected by SC 2023. Mumbai/Delhi/Bangalore have scenes; trans (hijra) legally recognised. PDA varies sharply by region.

womens_safety.text: India has well-documented safety concerns for women. Harassment ranges from staring and verbal comments to groping on crowded transport. Solo women should dress conservatively (cover shoulders, knees, and cleavage), avoid traveling alone at night, use women-only train carriages where available, and share live location with someone trusted. South India, Goa, and Kerala are generally safer for women than North India. The situation has improved with increased awareness and women-focused safety apps like Himmat Plus.
